about: The fixed benchmark set of tools/benchmark.py (docs/DEVTOOLS.md 'Visual benchmark', docs/ROADMAP.md 'Principle: improvements must generalise'). Places: docs/PLACES.md's table (group 'places'), its photo benchmarks (group 'photo') and a global set over every continent and biome, data-rich and data-poor, flat and steep, cities and wilderness (group 'global'). heldout = true: the held-out places, never looked at while tuning; run them (--set heldout or all) only to accept a change. Do not move a place or camera once runs exist: comparisons pair shots by place id and view name. Views: e/n offset (m east/north of the place) or lat/lon; 'back' = m behind the place along the view heading; height 'agl' (m above the ground there; the player's ground beyond the physics block) or 'alt' (m: with e/n the world z, ~ the height above sea level near the place; with lat/lon the height above the ellipsoid, curvature applied); heading 0 = north, 90 = east; pitch in degrees (negative = down); fov in degrees. Time: 'hour' local, 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD); the UTC offset is lon / 15 (local mean solar time, so 10:00 is the same sun everywhere) unless 'utcOffset' is given. Weather 'clear' (no clouds, 60 km visibility) or 'keep' (whatever the game has).
